items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Nagata scheme the normalized blowing up at a point is normal, Nagata and proper over the scheme (statement lines 1244-1248). The proof (proof lines 1249-1266) combines properness of blowing up, preservation of the Nagata property, and finiteness of normalization. H2: a complete short argument.
